trigger: a key or value name, or REG_SZ data, with an embedded NUL (NtCreateKey / NtSetValueKey; any user can write one under HKCU), rendered by enumerate_keys, enumerate_values or get_value
classification_rationale: CommandContext::write_output passes std::string{text}.c_str() to the C ABI, which reads to the first NUL, so the row is cut (subkey|A for A\0B; value|Run loses its type column) and the caller cannot tell
summary: Gate 7 B3. independently: 1 (Gate 4); referenced by CH-4. Synthesiser verified by read: plugin.hpp:70-72; registry_win.cpp:422 and :440 build the name with from_wide(name, name_len), which keeps an interior NUL (win_str.hpp:94-105 pops only a trailing one); sanitize_field does not fold NUL. Pre-existing and outside this diff, but it derives HIGH, so it gates by the letter of Gate 7. A blind NUL fold in sanitize_field is the wrong fix: REG_SZ data stored with an extra trailing NUL renders correctly today only because the ABI truncates, and would gain a trailing '_'. Needs a NUL rule (trim trailing NULs, then fold interior ones). Operator ruling: fix here, or a non-author adjudicated deferral to a P1 issue.

trigger: a REG_SZ / REG_EXPAND_SZ / REG_LINK value holding an interior NUL (any writer of the key; for HKCU the local user), read by get_user_value (or a ProfileImagePath read by list_profiles)

Fix the wording, not the shared decode (read_reg_value is shared with autoruns and execution_artifacts): narrow upgrading.md:15, README.md:17, :186 (also still 'sanitised against |/CR/LF' only), caveat 5 and changelog 6491:1 to names and get_value data, and say get_user_value / list_profiles read a string value up to its first NUL, as Windows does; regenerate registry.json.
